scripts.render:all: clapper render src/index.tsx -c ledger --out out/ledger.mp4 && clapper render src/index.tsx -c orbit --out out/orbit.mp4 && clapper render src/index.tsx -c nimbus --out out/nimbus.mp4 --crf 21 && clapper render src/index.tsx -c archdev --out out/archdev.mp4 --crf 20 && clapper render src/index.tsx -c archdev2 --out out/archdev2.mp4 --crf 20 && clapper render src/index.tsx -c archdev3 --out out/archdev3.mp4 --crf 20 && clapper render src/index.tsx -c archdev4 --out out/archdev4.mp4 --crf 20
scripts.review: for id in ledger orbit nimbus archdev archdev2 archdev3 archdev4; do clapper review src/index.tsx -c $id --video out/$id.mp4 || true; done
